activation: No model/native/train integration. Explicitly refuse execution admission while original bindings or exact token measurements are absent. All full290 cases/fixtures remain in original verifier.
context_binding: V binds visible identity, all original case/fixture roots, policy, renderer, tokenizer freeze, ordered selected complete units and diagnostic/task byte hashes; D=H(V); render(V,D); outer receipt binds exact prompt hash and counts. No self-hash cycle.
cost_semantics: Admission checks CPU/wall at bounded work checkpoints and on return; not a hard preemptive deadline. All actual scans, reads and selected bytes recorded. Input loader cost reported separately; no claim existing E5 compute budget is defined.
input_api: Exactly identity, identity_sha256, runtime, task, cases; exact v1 sanitized-byte identities. No root/path/store/after argument to selector.

packing.counterpart: paired .py/.pyx same qualname/kind, unique complete unit; include as one group or refuse
packing.mandatory: identity/header + primary diagnostic + resolved primary test/script + highest-ranked runtime group
optional_order: up to2 direct same-module helpers of primary test
first matched non-Python task fixture sorted path
remaining ranked runtime groups until original fixed limits
packing.overflow: mandatory item overflow refuses; optional whole item that does not fit is explicitly omitted, never sliced; no answer-driven retry
packing.primary_diagnostic: first failed case sorted classname/name, complete text; remaining case identities stay in full trusted manifest
packing.primary_script: first matched Python task script sorted path, complete bytes; do not AST unparse
packing.primary_task: complete matching original test function if uniquely resolved; generated/unresolved test body marked opaque, original verifier untouched

query.diagnostic_terms: case identity plus full original failure text
query.failure_cases: all failed original before cases, sorted by classname/name; no after outcomes
query.fixture_names: task basenames appearing as whole ASCII identifier tokens in original failed case names; this is a relevance hint, not a proven dependency closure
query.fixture_query: complete matched Python task scripts only; AST names/attributes/string constants excluding docstrings; unsupported syntax is recorded, never executed
query.mismatch_terms: only complete before diagnostic lines beginning E then + or -; remove diff prefix, tokenize

rank.admissible_unit_kinds: All exact v1 inventory units; no edits to task bytes. Unknown complete runtime boundaries refuse.

source_order: original case-sensitive fixed16 and original1/4/16/64 prefixes unchanged; no substitution
target_access: No target encoder in this first layer. Any future one must require immutable all16 input/source freeze before after-byte access and cannot affect retrieval.

terms.limit_order: descending occurrence count then lexical; no repository-specific rules
terms.regex: ASCII identifiers; CamelCase/snake_case split; lowercase; drop tokens shorter than3; plural trailing s removed only when length>4

token_measurement_status: NOT_EXECUTED; byte-bound views alone are not token/training admission

wire.checks: exact source/view, original unit intervals, strict integer types, overlap, adjacent insertion, no new/delete files, complete original inventory parse, coupled .py/.pyx; no retrieval retry
